content: If someone has overdosed and is experiencing severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call 911. If the situation is less critical, contact a poison control center without delay. In the United States, you can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. It is crucial to take each dose of your prescribed medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, consult your healthcare provider for guidance.
